title: AWFUL!
text: AWFUL!. These are awful! They are not soft, 1200 threads means nothing here. The fabric is very heavy. They feel like they've been permanently starched, washing did nothing to improve them. They were so wrinkled that despite immediate removal from the dryer, you'd need an industrial iron to improve them. Do NOT waste your money.

product_metadata.title: Royal Heritage Home 1,200-Thread-Count 100% Cotton Sateen Queen Sheet Set, White
features: Soft, luxurious queen sheet set with flat sheet, fitted sheet, and 2 standard pillowcases
Made of 100-percent cotton with 1,200-thread-count weave and glossy sateen finish
Fitted sheet features all-around elastic and extra-deep pocket for mattresses up to 18 inches deep
Comes in attractive neutral white color; also available in cameo, pecan, crystal, jade, and lilac
Machine-washable and dryer-safe; fits queen-sized beds
description: Experience resort-like luxury every night of the year--without spending $500 a night--with this 1,200-thread-count sheet set designed to pamper and indulge. Thanks to the 100-percent cotton construction and glossy sateen weave (which puts most of the threads on the surface), the sheets boast a glossy, lustrous shine and feel as elegant as silk. In addition, the sheets' neutral white color coordinates easily with most furnishings and won't compete with patterned comforters or blankets. The queen-sized set includes four pieces: a queen flat sheet, an oversized queen fitted sheet, and two standard pillowcases. The fitted sheet also offers an extra-deep pocket and elastic that stretches all the way around the edges to ensure a snug, durable fit on premium mattresses as tall as 18 inches. Meanwhile, the flat sheet and pillowcases both feature a 4-inch hem along the sides with self-piping for added style. As a final bonus, the items are machine-washable and dryer-safe and are made to grow softer with each cleaning. Other color choices include cameo, pecan, crystal, jade, and lilac.
Queen flat sheet, queen fitted sheet, two standard pillowcases.
